---
name: link-audit
description: Audit Ventura Build project and reference links for canonical destinations duplicates and stale material. Use when maintaining or releasing the learn-by-building catalog. Do not use when validating the shared repository CI workflow itself.
---

# Link audit

- Check links in changed learning-project sections.
- Prefer canonical documentation project or specification URLs.
- Detect duplicate destinations and redundant references.
- Flag dead moved or clearly obsolete material.
- Preserve historical references only when intentionally labeled.
- Recheck Markdown formatting after edits.
